cover_headline: Schweikert SMARTER Act Would Replace H-1B Lottery With Merit Points System

end.headline: Schweikert SMARTER Act Would Replace H-1B Lottery With Merit Points System
end.line: A merit-points system could affect Indian professionals who face decades-long green card waits.

facts: H.R. 10460 would scrap the lottery and set an initial cap of 85,000 visas under a new board
The bill would remove per-country caps on employment-based immigration
The bill is in the House Judiciary Committee with no hearing scheduled and is not law
